choose_sensors_help: Choose which device sensors Helmsman reports to Home Assistant.
configure_addresses: Configure your Home Assistant addresses, then connect to sign in.
cover_notifications_help: If this is enabled, notifications take over the app cover until dismissed
dashboard_unsupported: This dashboard is empty or uses custom HTML that the native renderer cannot show.
energy_cards_help: Energy cards stay in the Home Assistant frontend. Tap to open.
events_widget_off_help: If you enable the Helmsman widget in Settings → Events view, alerts show there instead of in the system notification list.
events_widget_on_help: The Helmsman Events View widget is on, so Home Assistant alerts show there instead of in the system notification list.
get_a_location_fix_if_older_than: Get a location fix if older than
home_on_internal_help: Always reports the location as 'home' when connected to the internal host
language_follows_system: System follows your Home Assistant profile language when signed in, otherwise the phone language. Restart Helmsman after changing language.
location_disabled: Location is disabled in Home Assistant.
location_fix_help: Helmsman only turns GPS on itself if the last fix is older than this - otherwise it uses fixes requested by other apps
location_mode_accurate: More frequent Home Assistant updates when a fix is available.
location_mode_balanced: A balance of update speed and battery use. GPS is not kept running.
location_mode_saver: Fewer Home Assistant updates for lower battery use.
native_dashboard_help: Render your dashboards natively instead of using the Home Assistant web UI. On by default. Unimplemented things still open in the webview.
no_entities: No lights, switches, scripts, ACs, or sensors found.
no_entities_with_graphs: No lights, switches, scripts, ACs, sensors, or graphs found.
notifications_registering: Notifications: registering device with Home Assistant…
report_location_help: Allow Helmsman to update the Home Assistant device tracker.
restart_for_engine: Restart Helmsman to apply the selected engine.
saved_session_found: A saved session was found. Retry restore, or sign in again on the configured address.
select_cover_entities: Select entities to show on the app cover
select_events_view_entities: Select entities to show in the Events View widget when enabled
select_events_view_entities_settings: Select entities to show in the Events View widget when enabled.
show_notifications_on_the_app_cover: Show notifications on the app cover
sign_in_prompt: Sign in to %1 with a Home Assistant user.
sign_in_to_home_assistant_first: Sign in to Home Assistant first.
single_address_help: To only use one address (and disable the switching logic), put the address in the external field.
switch_the_home_assistant_web_ui_to: Switch the Home Assistant web UI to %1.
too_many_sensors: Too many sensors match (%1). Type more of the name or entity id.
url_format_help: Use full URLs. Internal is usually http://<ip-address>:<port>, external something like https://example.io.nabu.casa
webview_engine_help: Choose which engine the webviews should be rendered in. Stock/ESR153/Atlantic are supported if installed
widget_needs_app: Helmsman must be running to show the widget
